title: Birds and Beaks
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'ea', 'oy' and 'ir'.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling sitting at the edge of a bare dirt path.
A small garden bird pecking at the dark dirt of the path.
Close view of a small bird's long, thin beak.
The bird's long beak pushed down into the loose dirt.
The bird lifting its beak with a small bug held inside it.
The small bird swallowing the bug, clearly pleased with its meal.
Ned the duckling and the small bird side by side, both looking content.
Close view of Ned the duckling's own flat, wide bill.
Ned the duckling dipping his flat bill into the shallow pond water.
Ned the duckling and the small bird eating side by side near the path.
